animation_declarations.name: surge_dynamics
animation_declarations.reason: depth is bathymetry-dominated; the surge lives in the free surface. Masked to wet nodes because TELEMAC sets FREE SURFACE = BOTTOM on dry land, so an unmasked field is scaled by the highest hill in the domain and the tide reads as a flat wash.

animation_declarations.name: inundation
animation_declarations.reason: depth over initially-dry land IS inundation - how water moves onto the land. Gated on bed > the run's own initial water line (the datum-corrected one it solved from), which is the discriminant flooded_land_km2 counts on.
